contracts.common_omitted_primary: designed and random predictions are compared only on the exact intersection of targets omitted by both k=8 panels; no selected truth is copied into these target-level contrasts
contracts.direct_residual_secondary: selected raw target scores are the only inputs; direct residual Ridge/PC1 and raw-to-derived residual Ridge/PC1 use identical exact panels, folds, omitted targets and evaluation rows
contracts.primary_deployment_model_unchanged: the manuscript deployment model remains raw-score prediction followed by residual derivation; direct residual training is sensitivity only
contracts.random_inference: three pre-existing fixed random panels per fold are descriptive Monte Carlo controls, first aggregated within fold

limitations: These are Vina score-reconstruction controls, not affinity validation.
Five chemical-group folds are descriptive composition sensitivities.
Only three fixed random panels per fold enter the common-omitted comparison.
Direct residual training is not the deployable primary policy.
